description: Cuba's prime minister on Thursday presented lawmakers with sweeping reforms backed by the Communist Party and former leader Raúl Castro that would privatize a ‌vast swath of its socialist economy in a bid to survive punishing U.S. sanctions.
title: Cuban PM floats sweeping reforms to privatize vast swath of economy

description: Canada Post said Thursday it has officially signed its new collective agreements with the Canadian Union of Postal Workers (CUPW), ending years of tense negotiations and strikes amid questions about the Crown corporation's future.
title: Canada Post, CUPW sign collective agreements, ending years of heated negotiations

description: The paint on Washington's newly renovated Lincoln Memorial Reflecting ‌Pool on Thursday was peeling away from the bottom and into the algae-tinted water, less than two weeks after U.S. President Donald Trump announced the job's completion.
title: Paint already peeling after Trump-ordered spruce-up of Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool

description: Members of Parliament ended spring sitting of Parliament today when they rose after question period and the House of Commons was adjourned until the fall.
title: Liberals tout 21 bills passing House of Commons this year as MPs break for summer

description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford faces criticism for comparing the planned Thunder Bay Correctional Centre to a Four Seasons Hotel. His comments come after the inquest for Kevin Mamakwa, who died in the old jail in 2020. He was the nephew of Kiiwetinoong MPP Sol Mamakwa, who said the premier's comments expose "the real Doug Ford."
title: 'When people commit crimes, they shouldn't be in this fancy-dancey jail,' Ontario premier says of new facility

description: Japanese government fair trade watchdog officials have inspected six major ice cream makers on suspicion of price-fixing, with local media calling it a cartel.
title: Here's the scoop on Japan's alleged ice cream cartel accused of price-fixing cool treats

description: U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth put NATO allies on notice Thursday, announcing a Pentagon review of America's military commitment to Europe and warning some countries will fail the assessment.
title: Hegseth orders review of U.S. troops deployed to NATO in fiery Brussels speech

description: Carney says $100M will come from province, $100M from feds.
title: Carney announces $200M for new school and health-care centre in Tumbler Ridge

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney and B.C. Premier David Eby are speaking Thursday ahead of a World Cup match between Qatar and Canada.
title: Carney, Eby speak as fans descend on B.C. ahead of Canada-Qatar World Cup match

description: Viewing areas for the New York Knicks championship parade were jam packed early this morning, but fans who couldn’t get in are still revelling in the team’s long-awaited NBA championship.
title: ‘Once in a lifetime’: NYC turns out for Knicks parade

description: Following an event last summer in which the musician was charged with attacking Los Angeles police officers, pop star Lil Nas X took to Instagram on Wednesday to share information on his bipolar disorder diagnosis and experience in rehab.
title: Lil Nas X gives update on mental health and new music: 'I'm just ... smelling the roses'

description: NHL says it completed a review of Mike Babcock's tenure in Columbus, clearing him to coach the Edmonton Oilers if they opt to hire him.
title: Mike Babcock cleared to coach Oilers after NHL reviews his Columbus tenure

description: A Canadian tourist has been shot and killed at the Kruger National Park in South Africa, according to officials there.
title: Canadian killed in South Africa wildlife park

description: Ivory Coast striker Elye Wahi, who is under investigation for alleged betting-related offences, has not been authorized to travel to Canada for his team's next World Cup match against Germany, the Ivorian soccer federation said on Thursday.
title: Ivory Coast's Elye Wahi denied entry to Canada at World Cup amid betting probe

description: New Yorkers held a ticker-tape parade and victory rally on Thursday for the Knicks men's basketball team that brought home the NBA championship after a 53-year drought.
title: IN PHOTOS | Knicks championship celebration

description: In order to be eligible for dual practice, doctors must do a minimum number of hours in the public system first. The province says those hour requirements along with other safeguards will protect the public system.
title: Eligible doctors in Alberta can work in both public, private systems starting this fall

description: The federal fiscal watchdog says Ottawa's plan to roll out automatic tax filing could see Canadians who normally don't file their tax returns get thousands of dollars in owed benefits annually.
title: Some low-income Canadians could get over $2K through automatic tax filing: watchdog

description: Six Nations of the Grand River elected council says it "strongly rejects" recent comments by a Brantford, Ont., city councillor who said he doesn't believe in land acknowledgments and thinks they're "virtue signalling."
title: Six Nations calls out Brantford, Ont., councillor who refused to give land acknowledgment before meeting
New law to strip Canada's military of power to handle sexual assault cases

description: The Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda has claimed more than 200 lives in its first month and is the worst known outbreak at this stage, with up to 35,000 suspected potential contacts, Africa's Centres for Disease Control and Prevention said on Thursday.
title: Ebola cases increase almost 40% in Congo, Uganda in a week as death toll passes 200

description: Actor Daveigh Chase, who became known as the voice of Lilo in the hit Disney animated feature Lilo & Stitch, died this week at the age of 35.
title: Daveigh Chase, former child star in Lilo & Stitch and Donnie Darko, dead at 35

description: A 4.5 magnitude moderate earthquake has shaken the Bas-Saint-Laurent, Gaspésie, and Côte-Nord regions Thursday morning.
title: Magnitude 4.4 moderate earthquake hits eastern Quebec

description: A 19-year-old has been arrested and charged in connection with a shooting at the U.S. consulate in March, said police.
title: 19-year-old arrested in connection with U.S. Consulate shooting in Toronto

description: Canadian retail investors will be able to access prediction markets through a Canadian company this summer, after the platforms had been banned for years. Prediction markets are experiencing explosive growth, and seen as both a financial vehicle and as gambling.
title: Hot bet summer? Soon Canadians will be able to trade on prediction markets

description: An estimated 20,000 children are stuck on Alberta’s Family Support for Children with Disabilities (FSCD) waiting list, facing years of delays to get speech, behavioural and other treatment or therapy for autism and various disabilities.
title: An estimated 20,000 Alberta kids face waiting years to get therapy for disabilities

description: A 14-year-old who was making plans to carry out a school shooting in Saskatoon will be under a terrorism peace bond for the next year.
title: Terrorism peace bond imposed on youth who planned school violence in Saskatoon

description: Innu Cultural Guardian Jodie Ashini says she thought National Indigenous Peoples Day, June 21, would be the perfect day to open the Innu Pakassiun exhibit at the Labrador Interpretation Centre in North West River.
title: Innu Nation accuses N.L. government of capping group’s history at 300 years — an 'erasure,' say Innu leaders

description: Ukraine hit a Moscow oil refinery for a second time in a week and disrupted commercial flights at Moscow airports in one of its biggest drone attacks since Russia's invasion more than four years ago, Russian officials said Thursday.
title: Ukraine hits Moscow oil refinery again, part of massive drone wave inside Russia

description: Sixty years after Agent Orange got sprayed at CFB Gagetown, veterans, military family members and some U.S. lawmakers are still raising concerns these herbicides could linger in the soil. They are calling for more testing as Canada redevelops the base.
title: 60 years ago, Agent Orange was sprayed at CFB Gagetown. Vets want to know: are toxins still in the soil?

description: Hydro-Québec has begun exporting electricity to New York City under a long-term contract that critics say comes at an awkward time, as Quebec grapples with growing demand at home and lower-than-usual reservoir levels.
title: Hydro-Québec powers up New York exports amid tightening energy reserves

description: A family of beavers that came to London in 2023 is thriving in west London, and preventing flooding by doing what they do best — building dams.
title: Leave it to the beavers: How the industrious mammals are helping to stop a London tube station from flooding

description: Premier Doug Ford’s government is on pace to sit for the fewest days of any Ontario government over the past five decades in a year when voters aren’t headed to the polls. And experts warn the decision to shorten the calendar at Queen’s Park comes with its strategic benefits — and pitfalls — for the Tories as the legislature settles into a 21-week break.
title: Ontario's legislature is set for its shortest sitting in decades. Here's what it means for the Ford government

description: The name "blue dot fever" comes from the blue dots on Ticketmaster's website, indicating unsold seats. Some fans say they're going to fewer shows because of the high price tag.
title: Some artists feeling 'blue dot fever,' fans say, as high ticket prices make concertgoers more selective

description: When Jenn Chen came out to her distant, traditionalist father, she was surprised to receive his comfort and reassurance. His reaction started to make more sense to her after he died and the secret he carefully hid from his family came to light.
title: When I talked to my dad about my queerness, I wish he told me how much we had in common
